WITH CRP_USERS_INVITATION_ACCEPTED AS ( SELECT DISTINCT CRP.LOGIN_ID,CRP.FULL_NAME,AD.ID FROM (SELECT LOGIN_ID, FULL_NAME, MAX(ACTIVE) AS ACTIVE, MAX(LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC) AS LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC FROM @{pipeline().parameters.TABLE_USER_HEADER} GROUP BY ALL ) CRP LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_USERS" AS AD ON lower(CRP.LOGIN_ID) = lower(AD.MAIL) LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUP_MEMBERS" AS ADG ON AD.ID = ADG.USER_ID WHERE CRP.ACTIVE = 1 AND AD.EXTERNALUSERSTATE = 'Accepted' AND AD.ID IS NOT NULL AND CRP.LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC > (SELECT DATEADD(DAY, @{pipeline().parameters.DAYS_DATEADD_LASTRUN},LAST_RUN) AS LAST_RUN FROM CES_REF.ADF.COEX_CRP_PIPELINE_LAST_RUN) ), USERS_IN_AD_GROUP AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ADG.MAIL AS LOGIN_ID, AD.ID AS USER_ID FROM RAW_PROD.CES_ADF.AD_USERS AD LEFT JOIN RAW_PROD.CES_ADF.AD_GROUP_MEMBERS AS ADG ON AD.ID = ADG.USER_ID where ADG.GROUP_ID = 'b3671d93-be47-4d38-bd09-fdabcd4f6a70' ), AUDIT_LOG AS ( select distinct "user_email" AS LOGIN_ID from CES_REF.ADF.AD_AUDIT_LOG where "operation" = 'SEND_CRP_REPORT_LINK' ), AUDIT_LOG_AD_ADD AS ( --ADDED select distinct "user_email" AS LOGIN_ID from CES_REF.ADF.AD_AUDIT_LOG where "operation" = 'ADD_TO_CRP_GROUP' AND "execution_datetime" < DATEADD(hour, -1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'Australia/Sydney', SYSDATE())) ), USERS_IN_RLS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT LOGIN_ID FROM @{pipeline().parameters.RLS_TABLE} WHERE TAXONOMY = 'CRP' AND MULTI_SCHEME_ID = 10000 ), NEW_DATA AS ( SELECT IA.LOGIN_ID , AD.USER_ID, IA.FULL_NAME FROM CRP_USERS_INVITATION_ACCEPTED IA LEFT JOIN USERS_IN_AD_GROUP AD ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(AD.LOGIN_ID) LEFT JOIN USERS_IN_RLS RLS ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(RLS.LOGIN_ID) LEFT JOIN AUDIT_LOG AL ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(AL.LOGIN_ID) LEFT JOIN AUDIT_LOG_AD_ADD ADL ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(ADL.LOGIN_ID) WHERE RLS.LOGIN_ID IS NOT NULL AND ADL.LOGIN_ID IS NOT NULL AND AL.LOGIN_ID IS NULL ) SELECT USER_ID ,LOGIN_ID ,'SEND_CRP_REPORT_LINK' AS OPERATION ,OBJECT_CONSTRUCT ( 'message','

Hi '||FULL_NAME||',
\nPlease find attached the link here. Feel free to reach out to us at abc@coexservices.com.au if you encounter any difficulties.
\n
\nRegards,
\n
\n
\n

','receiver',LOGIN_ID,'context','CRP','name',FULL_NAME ) as api_body FROM NEW_DATA
